verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document app-based triggers (Twitter, GitHub, thousands of apps via source-available integrations), plus HTTP/Webhook, Schedule, Email, and RSS triggers that can kick off workflows on new events like messages or form submissions, with test-event tooling and error handling/retries. Community feedback corroborates real-world use of these workflows in production scenarios. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of 'new record' style triggers across many apps and any documented limitations on trigger reliability at scale.
